description: This file defines the front-end route component for displaying a paginated list of events, including data fetching logic, rendering of event items, and navigation controls.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Fetches paginated events data from the backend API, using parameters extracted from the request URL, and returns the data for client-side rendering.

methods.name: EventsIndex
methods.description: React component that renders the list of events, handles pagination controls, and displays event details.
